summary: Jefferson County tower on the Warm Springs Reservation, started 1936 at 45 ft and now gone. No source found describes what remains at the site.

facts.status_note: Gone; no source describes what remains at the site today

access.note: On the Warm Springs Indian Reservation; visitors should ask the reservation before going near the site

events.note: Construction of a 45-foot tower started in spring 1936, per a fiscal 1936 forestry report as quoted by Forest Lookouts; the register dates the tower to the 1930s
Registered August 26, 2010; nominated by Ray Kresek

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. Only three pages and one quoted report; two WebSearches gave no new source. The 1936 start date rests on the Forest Lookouts quote; the original report was not located. The 'permission' access level follows from reservation land, not from a published visitor policy. The Lookout Butte on the Nez Perce-Clearwater National Forest (fs.usda.gov, Idaho) is a different tower and was not used. The record's 13.7 m height matches the 45-foot figure. A removal date and a site description may sit in reservation or tribal records; not searched.
